mapper.select: select * from approval_flow_node where flow_definition_id = #{flowDefinitionId} and del = 0 order by node_no
mapper.insert: insert into approval_flow_node (flow_definition_id, node_no, node_name, approval_mode, del, add_time, update_time) values (#{flowDefinitionId}, #{nodeNo}, #{nodeName}, #{approvalMode}, #{del}, #{addTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update approval_flow_node set del = 1, update_time = #{updateTime} where flow_definition_id = #{flowDefinitionId} and del = 0
